children: NVIDIA (NVDA) approved an extra $150B buyback, raising total planned repurchases to $235B through fiscal 2028; cites strong AI chip demand. Q3 earnings due November 17.
NVIDIA (NVDA) invested about $800 million in Reflection AI within a $2 billion round, valuing Reflection AI near $8 billion, reinforcing NVIDIA’s GPU ecosystem ties to the AI firm.
NVIDIA (NVDA) GPUs will power LSEG’s Tick History analytics—110 trillion rows across ~30 years—enabling in-place, faster trade and quote analysis for near‑real‑time market insights.
NVIDIA (NVDA) partners with chipmakers to embed AI across chip design and fabs, focusing on AI-driven tool flows, process control and production optimization for semiconductor manufacturing.
NVIDIA (NVDA) retreated from about $244. On the 4‑hour chart, TD Sequential flagged a buy signal, suggesting a possible short-term rebound within the next few candles.
NVIDIA (NVDA) says AI infra demand will outstrip component supply for years, CEO Jensen Huang downplayed an AI bubble. Shares and chip stocks fell during U.S. trading.
NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo accelerated Lam Research’s plasma-prediction simulations from days to milliseconds, showcasing NVDA’s AI-driven simulation speedup for semiconductor process modeling.
NVIDIA (NVDA) will supply DGX Spark, RAPIDS, real‑time inference, BioNeMo models and explore Cosmos and Omniverse use for edge AI, accelerated analytics and instrument automation in Danaher systems.
NVIDIA disclosed funding for four French startups and took an equity stake in medical reservations platform Doctolib, confirming its investments and strategic French tech exposure.
